bowl_config.observability_stack: Jaeger (OTLP HTTP/gRPC :4317, sample_ratio=0.10) + Prometheus (2s dual-node scrape) + Loki + Alloy + Grafana + bowl stats + pprof
bowl_config.storage_engine: StoreActor per disk (Pebble + 128 MiB 共享缓存 + 双缓冲 MPSC Group Commit + 单步在线 ForkDisk 硬链接切面与孤儿离线净化)
bowl_config.blob_layout: packs/<pack_id_hex16>.pack (64 MiB Append-Only Pack + 256 KiB 块网格 + 跨分支 os.Link 零拷贝共享与血统提交回收)
bowl_config.wal_sync_mode: pebble.NoSync Group Commit + Fsync/FsyncDir 双层并行落盘屏障 (fdatasync + LogData)
bowl_config.concurrency_model: 单盘独立 StoreActor 串行切面固化 + WriterEpoch 世代号栅栏 + 跨盘独立并发读写

tensorlake.boundary_note: 托管云沙箱与对象存储快照接口（不含客户端内核 FUSE 挂载握手）

tigris.boundary_note: 对象存储分支接口（HTTP API 读写，不含 POSIX FUSE 挂载层）

azure_blob.boundary_note: 云对象存储复制快照接口（HTTP API 读写，不含 POSIX FUSE 挂载层）

large_1gib.label: 多封包 NVMe 规模 (16 × 64 MiB = 1 GiB)

tree_5k.label: POSIX 多目录树规模 (50 子目录 × 100 × 4 KiB)
